QUESTS.name: First Steps
QUESTS.text: Welcome to Ashen Hollow, traveler. Every adventurer starts with firewood. Walk up to any tree outside town and chop some logs with the action button.

QUESTS.name: Ore and Fire
QUESTS.text: Good work. Head into Hollow Meadow and mine copper and tin. We will turn them into bronze.

QUESTS.name: The Smith’s Way
QUESTS.text: Smelt your ore at the furnace, then forge something at the anvil. An adventurer is only as good as their gear.

QUESTS.name: Hunter’s Work
QUESTS.text: Boars keep raiding our stores. Hunt a few and skin one. Leather from the loom keeps you alive out there.

QUESTS.name: Wolves of Silkwood
QUESTS.text: The Silkwood wolves grow bold. Take the Old Mill Road east through the pass to reach Silkwood, then thin the pack. When a red circle appears under you, roll out of it.

QUESTS.name: Into the Forge
QUESTS.text: An old evil stirs in the Sunken Forge, through the burning portal in the corner of Silkwood. Defeat Forgemaster Grull.

QUESTS.name: The Road to Varrow
QUESTS.text: You have outgrown this village. Walk the King’s Road south from Silkwood, a long march through bandit country, to Varrow, the capital by the sea. Touch its waystone and you can return in a blink.

QUESTS.name: Coin and Commerce
QUESTS.text: Monsters drop coins, and merchants buy almost anything. Visit a shop in Varrow and buy something useful. Walk up to a shop door to go inside.

QUESTS.name: Mire and Muck
QUESTS.text: Mirewatch, deep in the Duskmire, asks for help. Toads foul their water and a bog lurker stalks the pools.

QUESTS.name: Fangs of Frost
QUESTS.text: Highcairn, in the frozen north-east, is cut off by ice wolves and frost trolls. Buy warm furs from Sigrid if the cold bites.

QUESTS.name: Queen of the Sands
QUESTS.text: South of Sunspire Oasis lie the Kharos ruins, where the Sand Queen Ssera nests. Slay her and the Sun King’s crown is yours.

QUESTS.name: Across the Sea
QUESTS.text: Captain Maren at the end of Varrow’s pier sails to Dragonscale Isle, where dinosaurs still roam. See it with your own eyes.

QUESTS.name: Primal Hunt
QUESTS.text: Hunter Kael on the isle needs hides. Raptors hunt in packs; hornbacks only fight back when provoked.

QUESTS.name: The Ashen Wyrm
QUESTS.text: In the shadow of the volcano sleeps Ignirax, the Ashen Wyrm. Hire a party at the Salty Trout, brew draughts, and end it.

QUESTS.name: Tidings from the Sea
QUESTS.text: A new captain waits on Varrow’s pier: Isolde of the Gull’s Wing sails to the Tidewake Isles, six islands strung together by rope bridges. Land at Wreckers’ Landing, then walk the bridges east to Coralport.

QUESTS.name: Reefbreakers
QUESTS.text: Pirates, reef crabs and tide serpents plague the isles. Thin them out and Coralport will call you friend.

QUESTS.name: Saltbeard’s Hat
QUESTS.text: Captain Saltbeard rules Smugglers’ Key, over the rope bridge north of Palmreach. Take him down.

QUESTS.name: The Tide Queen
QUESTS.text: On the Drowned Reef, over the north bridge from Coralport, Thalassa the Tide Queen stirs. Her tentacles crush and her waves drown. Bring a party and roll out of the red.

QUESTS.name: Ashes in the East
QUESTS.text: At the far east edge of the Sunscar Wastes, Ashfall Pass climbs toward Emberreach, a land of lava rivers under Mount Pyrax. Walk the pass, cross the lava bridges and reach the forge city of Cinderhold.

QUESTS.name: Cinder and Glass
QUESTS.text: Cinderhold needs obsidian and peace. Hunt cinder hounds and magma imps, then break an obsidian golem in the Glassfields to the south.

QUESTS.name: The Molten King
QUESTS.text: Pyraxis sits on the Molten Throne north of the volcano, ringed by lava. Take the north road past the brimstone vents, cross the bridge, dodge the falling fire, and end his reign.

QUESTS.name: A Letter from Varrow
QUESTS.text: A royal rider brought this for you, sealed in black wax. “Something fell from the sky over Kingsvale. The Crown needs the hero of Emberreach.” Herald Bram waits below the castle in Varrow.

QUESTS.name: A Place of Your Own
QUESTS.text: Before the Crown sends you into the dark, it wants you rooted. Buy a homestead deed from Land Agent Hilda by the waystone. A hero needs a hearth to come back to.

QUESTS.name: A Trade to Master
QUESTS.text: Swords win battles. Smiths, cooks and healers win wars. Join the Guild with Registrar Oren and choose a trade, then fill two of their work orders.

QUESTS.name: The Riven Crater
QUESTS.text: East of Varrow, in Kingsvale, the ground is split open and glows violet at night. Go to the Riven Crater and see what fell.

QUESTS.name: Dust of the Stars
QUESTS.text: I am Elowen, keeper of the royal archive. The riftlings leave a glittering dust. Bring me ten pinches and I will tell you what it means.

QUESTS.name: Echoes in the Mire
QUESTS.text: The dust sings the same note as four places under the realm. The first is the Mire Warrens, beneath the Duskmire. The Bog King’s cult has been feeding the rift. Silence him.

QUESTS.name: The Frozen Seal
QUESTS.text: The second well of power sleeps under Frostfang Reach, in the Frostpeak Caverns. Hrimgar the Frost Giant guards it without knowing what it is. Take it from him.

QUESTS.name: The Sand King’s Key
QUESTS.text: The third lies in the Tomb of the Sand King, under the Sunscar Wastes. Anubek was buried with a key to the sky. He will not give it up.

QUESTS.name: Heart of the Mountain
QUESTS.text: The last well is the hottest. Under Mount Pyrax, in the Molten Depths, Ignis is the mountain’s heart. When he falls, the rift will have nothing left to drink.

QUESTS.name: Gather the Realm
QUESTS.text: The rift is starving, and starving things get desperate. Before the Star-Eater comes through, grow strong and stock up. The Crown asks for five great healing potions for the army.

QUESTS.name: The Star-Eater
QUESTS.text: Twice a day the rift opens and Voidmaw, the Star-Eater, reaches through into the Riven Crater. Watch the Events chip for the time. Bring friends. Bring potions. Bring everything.

QUESTS.name: Voidbreaker
QUESTS.text: The sky is closing. Bells ring in Varrow for the first time in a year. Come to the castle square. The whole city wants to see you.

QUESTS.name: Bells for a Hero
QUESTS.text: Varrow will feast for a week, and every bard in the realm is writing a song about you. But somebody has waited longer than all of them. Go home to Ashen Hollow. Captain Mara has kept your seat by the fire.

QUESTS.name: Smoke from the Chimney
QUESTS.text: You saved the realm, and you saved the little places in it too. A home needs more than walls, though. Travel to your homestead and build something cosy: flower beds, a bench by the pond, a fire pit. Tap your house to see what you can build.

QUESTS.name: New Faces in the Hollow
QUESTS.text: While you were away, new folk settled in Ashen Hollow. Baker Maudie fires her oven by the waystone, Woodcarver Ansel took over the old workshop, and little Tess follows everyone around asking questions. Go and say hello.

QUESTS.name: A Gift Goes a Long Way
QUESTS.text: Folk out here don’t need much. A warm loaf, a fresh fish, someone who remembers what they like. When you talk to someone, you can give them a gift. They will tell you what they love most. Give two gifts today.

QUESTS.name: Bread for the Hollow
QUESTS.text: My oven is hungry, and so is the Hollow. Bring me six sacks of flour from your mill and six eggs from your hens. If you have no mill or coop yet, build them at your homestead.

QUESTS.name: The Woodcarver’s Wish
QUESTS.text: I am carving a new sign for the Hollow, with your name on it. But the good pine grows out in Silkwood, and my knees are older than the trees. Twelve pine logs would do it.

QUESTS.name: Tess and the Goldfin
QUESTS.text: There is a GOLDEN fish in the river. Everybody says so. If you catch ten fish, one of them HAS to be it! Any river, any pond. Even the one at your house.

QUESTS.name: Old Tusker Returns
QUESTS.text: Old Tusker is back on the Old Mill Road east of the Hollow, flattening Farmer Tobin’s fences. He remembers you. He is still angry about it.

QUESTS.name: Friends Across the Realm
QUESTS.text: A hero belongs to everyone, not just to the Hollow. Visit the towns you saved and make friends. Chat with people every day and bring them something they love. Earn a heart with four people.

QUESTS.name: A Home Worth Coming Back To
QUESTS.text: Your land should feel like home when you walk up the path. Raise your homestead’s Comfort to 5. Every comfort also makes your rested XP pool bigger.

QUESTS.name: The Humming Well
QUESTS.text: Strange thing. The old well out in Hollow Meadow hums at night, the same note the crater used to make, and the water glows violet. Gather some dust from the riftlings at the Riven Crater and take it to Archivist Elowen in Varrow. She will know what it means.

QUESTS.name: Echoes of a Fallen Star
QUESTS.text: When Voidmaw fell, its heart did not die. It shattered. The shards scattered across the realm and hid inside the strongest creatures they could find, feeding on them. The crater dust glows near a shard, so we need more of it. A lot more.

QUESTS.name: The Violet Eye
QUESTS.text: The dust flared over Whitepine Pass. The Whitepine Alpha has grown a violet eye and hunts by day and night. Put the poor beast to rest and bring back its shard.

QUESTS.name: Something in the Causeway
QUESTS.text: The second shard sank into the Drowned Causeway, where the Mire hulk sleeps. Lantern-keeper Hob in Mirewatch has seen its glow over the water. Ask him where, then take the shard.

QUESTS.name: A Thief of Stars
QUESTS.text: Bandit chief Rook stole a shard and means to sell it to the highest bidder. His gang camps along the King’s Road and in Scorchwind Canyon. A star is not a trinket.

QUESTS.name: Snow That Glows
QUESTS.text: Elder Brann of Highcairn writes that the snow on Frostfang Reach glows purple at night, and the frost trolls have gone mad. Help his people, and he will tell you where the light is coming from.

QUESTS.name: A Gift for the Hall
QUESTS.text: The Jarl knows where the shard fell, but nobody walks into his hall empty-handed. Bring him three horns of hot mead, and cook two dishes in a real kitchen to show you can feed a hall.

QUESTS.name: The Giant Stirs
QUESTS.text: The shard fell through the ice into Frostpeak Caverns, right onto Hrimgar’s hoard. The giant is awake, and he has never been angrier. Clear the caverns again.

QUESTS.name: The Queen’s Nest
QUESTS.text: The next glow is far to the south. Ssera’s nest in the Kharos ruins has a new queen, and she hatched with a shard in her crown. Caravan master Idris at Sunspire Oasis will want to hear when she is gone.

QUESTS.name: Under the Dunes Again
QUESTS.text: Our camels will not walk past the old tomb any more. It sings at night. A shard has woken Anubek, and the Sand King wants his sky back. Clear the Tomb of the Sand King.

QUESTS.name: Teeth of the Isle
QUESTS.text: Sailors swear the Tyrant king on Dragonscale Isle bites with violet light. Captain Maren sails there from Varrow’s pier. Bring him the news when it is done.

QUESTS.name: Saltbeard’s Last Stand
QUESTS.text: Captain Saltbeard is back on Smugglers’ Key, and he fished a glowing stone out of the sea. Sail with Captain Isolde to the Tidewake Isles and finish him for good. Old salt Morgan in Coralport has waited years for this day.

QUESTS.name: A Shell to Listen With
QUESTS.text: The last shards hide where no eye can see them. Nami can hear them, if you bring her the makings of a listening shell: six coral shards from the reef rocks and two pearls.

QUESTS.name: Embers of the Star
QUESTS.text: The shell hums toward the east, toward the heat. Two shards burn in Emberreach: one in the Ashfall warden on the pass, one in the Magma titan below the volcano. Forge-master Hilde in Cinderhold can cage them.

QUESTS.name: The Lantern of Seven Shards
QUESTS.text: Seven shards, one cage. I will forge a lantern strong enough to hold them, but I need eight obsidian shards and six good iron bars.

QUESTS.name: Carry the Lantern Home
QUESTS.text: The lantern is done. Seven shards burn inside it, and they all lean the same way, like flowers toward the sun. West. Toward the place you started. Take it to your Archivist in Varrow.

QUESTS.name: The Door in the Meadow
QUESTS.text: The lantern points home, to the humming well in Hollow Meadow. The eighth shard, the heart of the star, fell into the old caves beneath your village, and it is still growing. The well is a door, and it will open for the lantern. Tell Captain Mara.

QUESTS.name: Rally the Realm
QUESTS.text: If something climbs out of that well, the whole realm should be ready. Visit your friends and tell them: Sergeant Voss in Varrow, Jarl Hrothgar in Highcairn and Forge-master Hilde in Cinderhold.

QUESTS.name: Potions for the Deep
QUESTS.text: Down there, nobody can run to the shop for you. Brew three potions at an alchemy bench. Granny Wormwood says it is the best way to learn what saves your life.

QUESTS.name: Strength for the Dark
QUESTS.text: The heart of the star is stronger than Voidmaw ever was. Train until you reach class level 58. Rest at home first: a cosy house fills your rested XP.

QUESTS.name: Hearth and Shield
QUESTS.text: Before you go, the Hollow wants to send you off properly, and so does the rest of the realm. Earn a heart with eight friends. They will all be thinking of you down there.

QUESTS.name: Into the Hollow Below
QUESTS.text: The well in Hollow Meadow is open. Take the lantern, go down, and find what is growing under our home. The Hollow Warden guards the second hall. Bring friends, bring potions, and come back.

QUESTS.name: The Last Star
QUESTS.text: Nyxara, the Last Star. The heart of the thing that ate the sky, and it took root under your home. Pull it out by the roots.

QUESTS.name: Morning in Ashen Hollow
QUESTS.text: The well is quiet and the water runs clear. The whole Hollow is out on the plaza with Maudie’s bread and Ansel’s new sign. Go and see them. They have been waiting all night.

QUESTS.name: Roots
QUESTS.text: You do not have to save the world every day. Some days you just grow carrots. Reach Farming level 12.

QUESTS.name: Good Neighbours
QUESTS.text: Real friendship takes time. Keep visiting, keep listening, keep bringing pie. Reach two hearts with three friends.

QUESTS.name: A Feast for the Hollow
QUESTS.text: The harvest festival is coming and my oven cannot do it alone. Cook six dishes in your kitchen, and bring me five jars of honey from your bees.

QUESTS.name: A Cosy Life
QUESTS.text: A fountain to listen to, a dog to greet you, a fire to sit by. Raise your homestead’s Comfort to 12.

QUESTS.name: Rare Sightings
QUESTS.text: I want to carve the rare beasts of the realm, but they only show themselves now and then. Check the Events list to see when one appears, and hunt three of them for me.

QUESTS.name: A Trade of Your Own
QUESTS.text: Every hero needs one thing they are truly good at that is not hitting things. Raise any skill to level 18: cooking, fishing, smithing, anything you love.

QUESTS.name: Best of Friends
QUESTS.text: Some friends you make in a day. The best ones take a lifetime, or at least a couple of weeks. Reach five hearts with someone.

QUESTS.name: Warden of Ashen Hollow
QUESTS.text: The elders met last night. They want to give you a title nobody has held for a hundred years: Warden of Ashen Hollow. All they ask is that you are as strong as you are kind. Reach class level 65, and show the Hollow Below that it stays empty.

QUESTS.name: The Bone Road
QUESTS.text: Diggers upriver found bones the size of ships, and now the bones are getting up. Bargeman Brask on Varrow’s pier runs the Dustrunner up to the Fossil Lands. Go to the diggers’ camp at Bonewatch and see what is happening.

QUESTS.name: Dust to Dust
QUESTS.text: The skeletons lie in the dirt like they are sleeping, then jump up when you pass. Rib Valley is full of them, north of the crossroads. Put some back down for good.

QUESTS.name: What the Graves Keep
QUESTS.text: South of the crossroads the Grave Fields stretch for a mile. Bone sentinels guard them. Thin them out, and dig a few graves while you are there. Mind who wakes up.

QUESTS.name: The Grave Lord
QUESTS.text: In the middle of the Grave Fields lies Mordrek, a lord of the old war. When he stands, the fields stand with him. Make sure he does not stand for long.

QUESTS.name: The Risen Horn
QUESTS.text: On Skull Hill, at the east end of the road, sleeps the biggest skeleton we ever found: a horned giant we call Vorrak. If it wakes, it will flatten this camp. Bring friends, wake it, and break it.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 1 · Ashen Hollow
CHAPTERS.blurb: A village at the edge of the world, and an adventurer with an axe.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 2 · The Realm
CHAPTERS.blurb: The King’s Road, the capital, and the towns at the edges of the map.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 3 · Beyond the Sea
CHAPTERS.blurb: Dragons, pirates, a tide queen and a molten king.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 4 · Cracks in the Sky
CHAPTERS.blurb: A star fell on Kingsvale. The dungeons of the realm began to hum.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 5 · The Star-Eater
CHAPTERS.blurb: Seal the four wells of power, gather the realm, and face what came through the sky.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 6 · Homecoming
CHAPTERS.blurb: The sky is whole again. Time to go home, meet the neighbours, and make a house a home.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 7 · Shards of the Star
CHAPTERS.blurb: The Star-Eater’s heart shattered. Its shards are hiding inside the strongest beasts of the realm.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 8 · The Hollow Below
CHAPTERS.blurb: Every shard points home. Something has taken root under Ashen Hollow.

CHAPTERS.name: Chapter 9 · A Life Well Lived
CHAPTERS.blurb: Fields, friends and a fire to come home to. Being a hero is also about the days in between.

TUT_STEPS.t: Walk to the glowing light. Use the joystick on the left (or WASD).
Look around: drag a finger on the right side of the screen. Pinch to zoom.
Talk to Guide Elara: walk up to her and tap the big button.
Tap CLASS at the top of the screen. It shows your class, spells and talents.
Chop a tree in the grove: stand next to one and tap the big button.
Mine one of the copper rocks with the big button.
Cook the raw trout Elara gave you at her campfire.
Tap BAG to see everything you carry.
Tap GEAR, tap the WEAPON slot, tap the training weapon Elara gave you and press Equip. (Tap any item to see its stats and options.)
Defeat 3 training toads in the pen. Tap ATTACK.
Cast a spell: tap one of the round buttons on the ring around ATTACK. Attack spells need an enemy nearby.
Red circles mean danger! When one appears under you, tap DODGE or run out before it fills.
You’re hurt! Tap the red HP button near the bottom of the screen to drink a health potion.

TUT_STEPS.t: Open the map: tap the minimap in the top right corner.
Training complete! Talk to Ferryman Oskar at the dock to sail to Ashen Hollow.
